text.p: Qualcomm Inc said on Tuesday it filed a lawsuit in U.S. federal court against Sweden's Telefon AB L.M. Ericsson and one of its units, alleging unfair competition.

The complaint filed in the U.S. District Court for the Southern District of California alleges a pattern of conduct by Ericsson intended to impede the acceptance and commercial deployment of Qualcomm's Code Division Multiple Access (CDMA) technology and products.
Allegations include that Ericsson published false and disparaging statements about the CDMA products and that Ericsson made baseless claims of patent infringement by Qualcomm.
Qualcomm also charges that Ericsson's patent infringement claims violate a 1989 non-disclosure agreement between the two companies.
Officials of Ericsson could not be immediately reached for comment.
